lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Front door was unlocked. It's never unlocked.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No answer. Just the hum of the refrigerator, and sodium-orange streetlight spilling through a broken window.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Okay. Breathe. Before I call anyone, I need to see what happened here.

lines.speaker: narrator

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: The kitchen. They barely touched it in here.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Every drawer yanked open, and the fridge still humming like nothing happened.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The flashlight beam slides under the couch frame and catches something pale.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: A feather? It's warm. Like it was just...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Away from the beam it keeps glowing: faint, gold, steady.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere outside, a church bell rings once. There's no church on this street.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: Glass blown out onto the porch. The spare key gone. Not a scratch on the lock.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: And a feather that glows in the dark.

lines.speaker: eli
lines.text: None of this fits a normal break-in. I need to lay it all out and think before I walk out that door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [End of the Milestone 1 slice. Next milestone: the deduction board, where you connect this evidence to unlock the way forward.]
